title: Europe’s Hera Probe Sees Two Asteroids Instead of One
paragraphs: A space probe called Hera is flying to two asteroids. They are named Didymos and Dimorphos. Dimorphos is the small one.
In 2022, a NASA probe hit Dimorphos on purpose. Its path around Didymos changed. Now Hera wants to look at the result.
In October 2026, Hera took a new photo. For the first time, it showed two asteroids, not one. Hera will come closer soon.
